name: musubi-claude
description: First-class Claude Code adapter for Musubi memory: recall that runs before Claude answers, memory that survives /compact, live thoughts from other agents, automatic capture with verified delivery, recall tools, a memory steward and an honest health check. Shadow-only by default: nothing is written to Musubi, and prompts are never sent as searches, until delivery_mode is set to verified.

actor.title: Musubi actor
actor.description: Your Musubi identity, e.g. alice. Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Leave empty to keep using an existing config.json.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: This machine or agent seat, e.g. laptop. Your presence becomes actor/seat.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Which zone this seat belongs to.

delivery_mode.title: Delivery mode
delivery_mode.description: shadow keeps captures local (nothing leaves this machine); verified sends them to Musubi and reads each one back.

musubi_url.title: Musubi URL
musubi_url.description: Your Musubi server, e.g. https://musubi.example.com. Leave empty to keep an existing memory-data setup.

musubi_token.title: Musubi token
musubi_token.description: Your Musubi API token (a JWT). Stored in the system credential store, never in settings.json.

prompt_recall.title: Prompt recall
prompt_recall.description: Before each answer, search Musubi with your prompt and add the few memories that are actually about it. auto: only when Delivery mode is verified (the prompt text is sent as the search query). A prompt that looks like it contains a credential is never sent.

thought_sources.title: Live thought sources
thought_sources.description: Comma-separated presences whose thoughts to your presence should arrive live in the session (verified mode with a Musubi URL and token), e.g. yua/laptop,tama/desk. Leave empty for no live feed.
